ValidationRule.description: This is to ensure we capture more detail related to Case Reason
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = 'Questions', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Reason, "")), CreatedDate > DATETIMEVALUE("2025-10-23 00:00:00"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Case_Sub_Reason__c)) )
